unit.why: A short passage on repentance from an anthology chapter (מענין תשובה). It cites R. Elimelech's statement that he repented and mortified himself even for acts done as a nursing infant, adds a one-line Talmudic example (Shabbat 12b) and closes with a prayer. It is exemplary teaching, not a developed narrative.
unit.boundary_note: part of a thematic chain of citations on repentance that continues into the next division
